description: Use this when the user wants to propose a barter trade for someone else's listing, optionally offering one of their own listings in exchange. Sends the proposal to the listing's owner, who is notified by email. Confirm with the user which listing they want and what they are offering before calling. A pending proposal can be withdrawn with withdraw_proposal.

message.description: A note to the listing's owner

proposer_listing_id.description: The user's own listing offered in exchange

name: create_proposal
title: Propose a trade
